summary: Two independent path corrections confirmed against developer.concur.com: location search lives under the newer Localities v5 resource family (not a guessed 'Locations v4'), and Attendee Types v4 is a bare top-level path, not nested under /expenseconfig/.
reason: Both paths were LOW-confidence guesses (resource name only, no fetched URI template). locations.search 404'd against /locations/v4/locations with a query param named 'query'; the real resource is /localities/v5/locations with a free-text param named searchText. attendee_types.list 500'd against /expenseconfig/v4/attendeetypes; the real resource is the bare /v4/attendeetypes.

changes.description: path corrected to /localities/v5/locations; query param renamed from 'query' to 'searchText' to match the real API.
resourceReadPaths['locations'] and resourceReadPaths['attendee_types'] updated to match.
syncResourcePath()'s locations and attendee_types entries updated to match.

validated_outcome: locations.search: live-tested, HTTP 200 (valid empty result for 'New York' -- corporate location catalogs use structured locality codes, not free city names, so an empty match set is expected behavior, not a failure). attendee_types.list: live-tested, HTTP 403 with 'The OAuth Consumer must have one of these roles: Web Services Administrator, Expense Configuration Admin, or Expense Configuration Restricted' -- confirms the path is now correct AND confirms developer.concur.com's stated 'company access tokens only' requirement; this is a real, permanent auth-model boundary for cookie-session callers, not a further path bug. Documented in spec.yaml as AUTH-GATED.
